strings.title: 打字寵物
strings.tag: 一次學一個鍵，練習打英文字母和單字，每完成一課就孵出一隻寵物！
strings.how1: 把手指放在基準列上：左手放 A S D F，右手放 J K L ;。
strings.how2: 摸摸看 F 和 J 上的小凸點，不用看鍵盤也能找到基準位置。
strings.how3: 打出亮起來的字母。完成這一課，就能敲開蛋、孵出寵物！
strings.hello: 選一課開始吧！每一課最後都有一顆蛋可以敲開！
strings.locked: 先完成前一課，才能打開這一課。
strings.petsSub: 完成課程就能孵出更多寵物。拿到 3 顆星會得到金蛋和閃亮寵物！
strings.start: 按空白鍵或點「開始」就可以開始。
strings.shiftHint: 要打大寫字母，用另一隻手的小指按住 Shift。
strings.keepGoing: 做得好！再試一次，拿更多星星。
strings.eggReady: 你的蛋準備好了！點一下或按任意鍵把它敲開。
strings.noKb: 用鍵盤練習打字效果最好。你也可以點下面的按鍵。
strings.tickTip: 打錯了嗎？沒關係。找到亮起來的鍵，再試一次。
strings.intro_l01: 把左手食指放在 F，右手食指放在 J。摸摸看上面的凸點！
strings.intro_l02: 中指放在 D 和 K，就在 F 和 J 旁邊。
strings.intro_l03: 無名指放在 S 和 L。
strings.intro_l04: 小指放在 A 和 ; 鍵。這樣就是完整的基準列了！
strings.intro_l05: 用基準列的按鍵打出真正的英文單字。
strings.intro_l06: 食指往中間伸到 G 和 H，打完再回到基準位置。
strings.intro_l07: 從 D 往上伸到 E，從 K 往上伸到 I。
strings.intro_l08: 從 F 往上伸到 R，從 J 往上伸到 U。
strings.intro_l09: 用食指往上、往旁邊伸到 T 和 Y。
strings.intro_l10: 無名指往上伸到 W 和 O。
strings.intro_l11: 小指往上伸到 Q 和 P。
strings.intro_l12: 練習用上排和基準列打出的英文單字。
strings.intro_l13: 從 F 往下伸到 V，從 J 往下伸到 M。
strings.intro_l14: 中指往下伸到 C 和逗號。
strings.intro_l15: 食指往下伸到 B 和 N。
strings.intro_l16: 無名指往下伸到 X 和句點，小指往下伸到 Z。
strings.intro_l17: 練習用到每一排按鍵的英文單字。
strings.intro_l18: 大寫字母：用一隻手的小指按住 Shift，再用另一隻手按字母。
strings.intro_l19: 打出完整的英文句子，記得用大寫字母和句點。
strings.intro_l20: 速度挑戰！先打正確，再慢慢加快。
strings.intro_l29: 現在要打整段文字了。眼睛看著文字，不要看手指。
strings.intro_l30: 保持穩定的節奏。打得順比打得急更快。
strings.intro_l31: 注意人名和地名的大寫字母，用另一隻手按 Shift。
strings.intro_l32: 數字和單字混在一起。手指伸到數字列，打完再回到基準位置。
strings.intro_l33: 引號是 Shift 加上單引號鍵，用右手小指按。
strings.intro_l34: 一整段的速度練習。放輕鬆，繼續打下去。
strings.intro_l35: 比較長、單字也比較難的文章。先求正確，再求速度。
strings.intro_l36: 一段簡短的歷史。打字時，眼睛先往前多看幾個字。
strings.intro_l37: 有數字、冒號和逗號的步驟說明。
strings.intro_l38: 有對話和標點符號的故事。每個符號都慢慢打。
strings.intro_l39: 分號、連字號和單引號，全都在這一段裡。
strings.intro_l40: 最後的挑戰！打得順暢，錯了馬上改，堅持到最後。
strings.intro_l21: 從 F 往上伸到 4，從 J 往上伸到 7。其他手指留在基準位置。
strings.intro_l22: 食指伸到數字列中間的 5 和 6。
strings.intro_l24: 無名指往上伸到 2 和 9。
strings.intro_l26: 單字和數字一起打，像是 3 cats 和 12 dogs。
strings.intro_l27: 問號是 Shift 加上 / 鍵，驚嘆號是 Shift 加上 1。
strings.intro_l28: 單引號在 ; 旁邊，連字號在 0 旁邊。兩個都用右手小指按。
strings.testsSub: 在時間結束前，盡量多打一些。
strings.testsLocked: 完成第 12 課就能打開打字測驗。
strings.bestWpm: 最佳：每分鐘 {n} 個單字
strings.intro_test: 在 {n} 分鐘內盡量多打。按下第一個鍵就開始計時，打錯了隨時修正。
strings.intro_tricky: 這些是你最常打錯的鍵。慢慢來，每一個都打對。
strings.ownSub: 用自己的文字出一份課程或計時測驗，再分享班級代碼或指派給班級。
strings.textHint: 英文字母、數字、空格和 . , ; : ' " - ! ? ( )。每一行依序打。10 到 1,500 個字元。
strings.codeHow: 學生打開打字寵物並輸入這個代碼，或由你指派給班級。
strings.delAsk: 要刪除這個課程嗎？它的班級代碼和連結將無法使用。
strings.saveErr: 儲存失敗。請確認內容只有鍵盤上的按鍵，而且沒有個人資料或不友善的內容。
strings.badChars: 這些字元無法在打字寵物中輸入：{chars}
strings.tooShort: 請至少輸入 10 個字元。
strings.codeBad: 這個代碼不能用，請跟老師確認。
strings.missing: 這個課程已經不在了，請跟老師要新的代碼。
strings.passNot: 還沒通過，你需要{what}。再試一次就能敲開蛋！
strings.needRule: 老師要求在前一課達到{what}，才能打開這一課。
strings.ruleNot: 老師要求達到{what}才能打開下一課。再試一次這一課吧！
strings.keyboardHint: 選擇你使用的語言和鍵盤。

sentences: The cat sat on a mat.
We can play in the park.
She has a big blue kite.
My pet is soft and kind.
The moon is bright at night.

paras.l29: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood. They can change color in less than a second to hide from fish that want to eat them. An octopus can also squeeze through any gap that is bigger than its beak.
paras.l30: The Moon is about a quarter of the size of Earth. It has no air, so there is no wind to blow away the footprints left by astronauts. Those prints could stay there for millions of years.
paras.l31: Maya and her brother Leo flew from Chicago to Lisbon in June. On Tuesday they rode a yellow tram up a steep hill, and on Friday they visited Aunt Rosa, who lives near the sea in a little blue house.
paras.l32: Our class planted 24 seeds on March 3. After 10 days, 18 of them had sprouted. By the end of April the tallest plant was 35 centimeters tall, and we picked 7 ripe tomatoes in the first week of June.
paras.l33: "Can we go outside?" asked Sam. "Not yet," said Mr. Park. "First, finish your page." Sam typed as fast as he could. "Done!" he called. "Great," said Mr. Park, "now we can all go out and play."
paras.l34: Every morning the baker wakes up before the sun. She mixes flour, water, salt, and yeast, then waits for the dough to rise. By seven o'clock the shop smells of warm bread, and a line of hungry people is waiting at the door.
paras.l35: Plants make their own food through a process called photosynthesis. Their leaves take in sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide, and they turn them into sugar and oxygen. The oxygen escapes into the air, which is lucky for every animal that needs to breathe.
paras.l36: Long before paper, people wrote on clay tablets, animal skins, and strips of bamboo. Around two thousand years ago, papermakers in China learned to mash plant fibers in water, spread the pulp on a screen, and dry it in the sun. Paper was cheap, light, and easy to carry.
paras.l37: How to make a paper boat: (1) Fold a sheet in half from top to bottom. (2) Fold the top corners down to the middle. (3) Fold the bottom edges up on both sides. (4) Open the middle and flatten it into a square. (5) Pull the sides out gently, and your boat is ready to sail.
paras.l38: The storm knocked out the lights just as the game began. "Don't worry," said Grandpa, lighting a candle. "We'll play the old way." He found a deck of cards in the drawer, and for three hours nobody missed the screen at all. When the power came back, they kept playing.
paras.l39: It wasn't easy; the trail was steep, muddy, and full of roots. Still, the hikers kept going - one slow step at a time - until they reached the top. "Was it worth it?" asked Jo. Everyone looked at the view and laughed; nobody needed to answer.
paras.l40: Hummingbirds are the smallest birds in the world, yet they are amazing athletes. Their wings can beat more than 50 times a second, and their hearts can beat over 1,000 times a minute. They can fly forward, backward, and even upside down, and each day they visit hundreds of flowers to drink sweet nectar.
